Great hospitality, amazing Vietnamese cuisine!
Dec 2024 • Couples
We chanced upon Sapa 24 while looking for lunch yesterday and ordered Bánh Xèo as well as Grilled Fish with lemongrass and chilli. Both dishes were so good, it got me thinking of the food the whole day. This evening, we returned and tried the hotpot and were immensely impressed. The lady owner recognised us and was so hospitable! 

We were so pleased with the hotpot (great variety and generous servings!) that we told a group of people who walked in, that this restaurant’s food is impressive!
